caption: The drawing features a square piece of fabric depicted with a plaid pattern, situated centrally on a plain, light beige background with some subtle discoloration and small spots visible. The fabric pattern is composed of intersecting bands in various colors including red, green, blue, orange, and cream. The bands cross each other at right angles, creating a grid of differently colored squares and rectangles. The predominant colors in the top and side borders are shades of red and orange, while the central portions have larger bands of green and blue, along with some cream-colored lines. The colored bands have diagonal hatching, representing the texture of woven fabric. At the lower right side, there is a neatly written signature in pencil that reads “Arthur G. Mackley.”
title: Plaid Woolen Blanket
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
